law_name: Wirtschaftliche Basishilfe (economic basic assistance pilot for undocumented migrants / Sans-Papiers)
description: As head of the Social Department, Golta launched a pilot programme channelling cash-equivalent basic assistance to undocumented migrants (Sans-Papiers) via aid organisations, with the city council approving roughly CHF 2 million for an 18-month pilot. The aim was to reach people who avoid regular social welfare for fear of immigration consequences.
significance: A signature and highly contested element of his social-policy record; later ruled unlawful by the district council and cantonal government for circumventing mandatory reporting to migration authorities, and challenged before the administrative court.

law_name: Inclusion and poverty-reduction measures (scholarships, heating-cost allowance, daycare wage subsidies)
description: During twelve years heading the Social Department, Golta introduced scholarships for provisionally admitted foreigners and for adult further education, a heating-cost allowance, and wage subsidies for staff of private daycare centres.
significance: Defines his redistributive, inclusion-focused approach as Zurich's social director.
